scope_note: Independent challenge set (32 cases) authored on the second machine (Linux/Python 3.14.4) from the five frozen ARRO pages only; it was forbidden from reading glossary.json, the existing case files, or the retriever, and was frozen before the stage-190 passage A/B. answerable=false cases have no evidence; a returned candidate for them is a false candidate, not a generation hallucination. applicable_year is 'unknown' unless the quoted sentence itself names the year or cohort. The evidence wrapper adds an empty evidence list to the nine unanswerable cases for schema compatibility; the page-level heldout_190_cases.json is byte-identical to the generated file.

provenance.generator: DSH headless on the dorm machine, job-0926-195834-58
provenance.note: The raw freeze record is kept out of the repository; this header and tools/rag_data/README.md record the provenance. No case was edited after generation.

cases.query: In the Master Class Schedule, what does a 'Part of Term' value of S indicate about a course?
cases.caveat: The terminology table only explains the column; which term an individual course actually belongs to still has to be checked in the live Master Class Schedule.

evidence.quote: Description “S” under the heading means the course does not follow the regular term.

cases.query: In the Master Class Schedule terminology list, what does Cap mean for a course or course section?
cases.caveat: Cap is the maximum quota; how many seats are actually left is a different column (Avail) and is live data.

evidence.quote: Maximum quota for the course or course section.

cases.query: Within the hour, when do CityU classes start and finish?
cases.caveat: This is the University class-hour rule; the actual meeting time of a section is shown in the personal class schedule.

evidence.quote: All classes start on the hour and finish at 10 minutes to the hour.

cases.query: I am a College of Business student majoring in Accountancy (AC). Can I register for a section marked 'only for College: CB' and 'not for Major AC'?
cases.caveat: Eligibility follows the restriction printed on the section itself; the current course catalogue and any approval from the course-offering unit still apply.

evidence.quote: it means the course can be taken by students in College of Business but except for those from AC (Accountancy) Major.

cases.query: I was admitted to a normative 4-year degree in 2019/20. According to the regulations currently published on the ARRO page, what minimum CGPA applies to me for the award of my degree?
cases.caveat: The 2.00 CGPA text in AR16.3/AR16.4 is for students admitted in 2020/21 and thereafter; the footnote keeps 1.70 for the 2019/20-and-before cohort.

evidence.quote: For students admitted in 2019/20 and before, the minimum CGPA requirement is 1.70.

cases.query: What is the exact last date for adding or dropping a course in Semester A 2026/27?
cases.unanswerable_reason: The registration page's Key Dates block contains event labels only (for example 'Course add/drop period ends'); the dates are injected by JavaScript from a separate spreadsheet and no concrete date appears anywhere in the text of the five pages.
cases.caveat: For a real deadline, check the ARRO Key Dates / the current term's AIMS pages.

cases.query: What is the student residence (hall) application deadline for 2026/27?
cases.unanswerable_reason: None of the five ARRO pages contains any student residence or hall application information, so there is no evidence to answer with.
cases.caveat: Contact the Student Residence Office / the hall application channel instead.

cases.query: How many seats (Avail) are left right now in a particular course section for Semester A 2026/27?
cases.unanswerable_reason: The pages only define what the Avail column means; the seat count itself is real-time dynamic data held in the Master Class Schedule behind the Portal/AIMS, not in the page text.
cases.caveat: Look up the live Master Class Schedule after signing in.

cases.query: 我在 2025/26 學年入學，通識教育（Gateway Education）要修多少學分？
cases.caveat: 31 學分只適用於 2025/26 及之後入學的學生；2024/25 及之前入學的是 30 學分。

evidence.quote: The Gateway Education requirement of 31 credit units mentioned in AR 4.7.1 only applies to students admitted in 2025/26 and thereafter.

cases.query: 我是 2022/23 學年入學的四年制本科生，AR4.9.2 所指的大學要求（實習／顧問項目／研究項目）是否適用於我？
cases.caveat: 這項要求只適用於 2022/23 及之後入學的四年制學位學生。

evidence.quote: The University Requirement stipulated in AR4.9.2 only applies to normative 4-year degree students admitted in 2022/23 and thereafter.

cases.query: 休學（leave of absence）最短可以多久？最多可以累積多少個學期？
cases.caveat: 休學須先獲批准，而且每個學期都要繳付續讀費（continuation fee）。

evidence.quote: Periods of approved leave of absence may not be less than one full semester, and may not accumulate to more than four semesters.

cases.query: 我打算修讀雙學位（double degree），第五年及之後所修的學分是否要自費？
cases.caveat: 四年內超出 144 學分以及第五年起所修的學分都以自資方式收費；細節以 Fees and Charges 為準。

evidence.quote: credits taken in the 5th year of study and beyond will be charged on a self-financing basis.

cases.query: 如果在加退選期限（add/drop deadline）之後才申請退選，最遲要在何時提交？
cases.caveat: 遲退選須由開課學術單位主管批准，而且只在特殊情況下才會獲批；同一條規則在 registration 與 faq 兩頁都有。

evidence.quote: must be submitted no later than the end of the teaching period for the relevant semester/term
must be submitted no later than the end of the teaching period for the relevant semester/term

cases.query: 如果我不屬於某個科目組別指定的學院或主修，但想修讀該科，應該怎樣做？
cases.caveat: 要透過非網上課程的電子表格向開課單位申請，並在最後一個 time-ticket 內提交。

evidence.quote: Students who do not belong to those groups but wish to take the course should seek approval from the course-offering units
during the last time-ticket

cases.query: 2026/27 學年 Semester B 的網上報名時間票（time-ticket）在哪一天開始？
cases.unanswerable_reason: Key Dates 區塊只有事件名稱（例如 Available of web registration time-tickets），實際日期由 JavaScript 從外部檔案注入，五頁文字中沒有任何日期。
cases.caveat: 請查 ARRO Key Dates 或登入 AIMS 查看。

cases.query: 我今個學期的 personal time-ticket 是幾月幾日幾點？
cases.unanswerable_reason: 個人 time-ticket 屬個人化資料，只可登入 AIMS／Portal 查看；這五頁沒有任何個人時間表或個人時段資料。
cases.caveat: 登入 AIMS 的 Course Registration 查看自己的 time-ticket。

cases.query: 我是全日制本科生，这学期想少修一些（低于12个学分），应该怎么申请？
cases.caveat: 须以电子表格提出申请，并交由所属学院或学系考虑。

evidence.quote: Students who wish to take a reduced study load in a semester (full-time students less than 12 credits) due to special circumstances may make an application via an electronic form available

cases.query: 我在入学前八年以前获得的学分，还能用来转学分吗？
cases.caveat: 个别学院可以订出更严格的年限要求。

evidence.quote: Transfer credits must have been earned no earlier than eight years before the date of enrolment at the University.

cases.query: 要获得学位，除了专业要求之外，还必须满足哪些语言方面的要求？
cases.caveat: 英文与中文（如适用）语言要求以大学公布的要求为准。

evidence.quote: Students are required to fulfil the English language requirement and Chinese language requirement, as appropriate, in accordance with the requirements stipulated by the University.

cases.query: 我入学时还没有申报主修（undeclared major），什么时候需要申报？
cases.caveat: 实际时间表与程序以 Declaring a Home Major 页面为准。

evidence.quote: In mid to late May of your first year of study.

cases.query: 我在学习计划里列出的课程，能保证一定选上吗？
cases.caveat: 课位取决于教师与其他资源，列入计划并不保证有位置，也不保证没有时间冲突。

evidence.quote: Listing a course in your plan does not guarantee that the course will have available places for your registration

cases.query: 如果因为学业原因被终止学业，还可以申请重新入学吗？
cases.caveat: 因学业原因被终止学业的学生不获考虑重新入学。

evidence.quote: For termination of studies due to academic reasons, students will not be considered for readmission to the University.

cases.query: 2026/27 学年本地生工商管理学士（BBA）一年级的学费是多少港元？
cases.unanswerable_reason: FAQ 只说学费取决于课程、公民身份与学籍，并指向 Fees and Charges 页面；这五页中没有任何金额数字。
cases.caveat: 请查 Fees and Charges 页面的最新收费表。

cases.query: 我忘记了 AIMS 密码，应该怎样重置？
cases.unanswerable_reason: 这五页只把 AIMS 当作操作入口引用，完全没有账号或密码重置流程的说明。
cases.caveat: 请联络 IT 服务台或 CityU 的账号服务渠道。

cases.query: Master Class Schedule 里面 WEB 一栏写 N 是什么意思？我还可以 online add/drop 吗？
cases.caveat: 这类科目不是 web-enabled，要经开课单位批准（用电子表格）才可加退选。

evidence.quote: Description “N” under the heading means they are NOT web-enabled.

cases.query: DegreeWorks 的 What-if scenario 可不可以 save？
cases.caveat: 答案只讲储存问题；画面操作与打印方式以 DegreeWorks 实际界面为准。

evidence.quote: No, the What-if scenario cannot be saved in DegreeWorks.

cases.query: 系统弹出 Too many requests ahead of you 的提示，是不是 server 出了问题？
cases.caveat: 这是注册高峰期的网络流量管制措施，应该稍后再试，而不是服务器故障。

evidence.quote: As a measure of network traffic control, it is a standard measure to restrict the number of accesses to the server to maintain the operation of the server.

cases.query: 我是 2020/21 至 2023/24 入学的 4-year degree 学生，Degree with Distinction 是按 GPA 排名还是绝对分数决定？
cases.caveat: 排名是相对同一学系／学院同期毕业的同学计算，而且 Dean 可按学术单位建议作例外处理。

evidence.quote: For Students on Programmes of a Normal Study Duration of 4 Years or More (Admitted from 2020/21 to 2023/24)
Degrees with Distinction are awarded based on the CGPA ranking for students in the respective departments/schools graduating in the same semester/term.

cases.query: DegreeWorks worksheet 上面的 area GPA，和 transcript 上面的 GPA，哪一个才是 official 的？
cases.caveat: worksheet 上的 area GPA 仅供参考；官方 GPA 只在成绩单上。

evidence.quote: Only the GPA as shown in your transcript is the official GPA recorded by the University.

cases.query: Registration 页说的 time-ticket (period) 到底是做什么用的？
cases.caveat: time-ticket 是分配给学生的一段注册时段；实际日期与时段要登入 AIMS 查看。

evidence.quote: change course sections during the specific registration time-ticket (period)

cases.query: 我在 2026/27 Semester A 某科的 supplementary exam 具体安排在几号？
cases.unanswerable_reason: 五页没有考试时间表或补考安排；规例只提到 I grade 之后最迟四周要评定成绩的规则，并不涉及任何具体日期。
cases.caveat: 请查教务处／学院的考试时间表。

cases.query: 我提交了 late drop 申请，会不会获批？
cases.unanswerable_reason: 规例与 FAQ 只说迟退选申请会按个别情况考虑、不保证获批，并须由开课单位主管批准；五页没有任何判据可以推出个别申请的结果。
cases.caveat: 结果只能由开课学术单位按个别情况决定。
